epics.title: Project Workspace Management
epics.description: Enable users to create, open, and manage multiple projects with isolated contexts
epics.business_value: Foundation for multi-project workflows, enables context isolation
acceptance_criteria: User can create unlimited projects
Each project has isolated chat history and documents
Projects persist across app restarts
Progress tracking visible on project cards

stories.title: Create New Project
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want to create a new project by providing a name and root directory, so I can start organizing my work immediately.
acceptance_criteria: Modal dialog with fields: Project Name (required), Root Directory (file picker), Description (optional)
System validates: name not empty, directory exists and is writable, no duplicate names
On success, create: SQLite database in root, context/ folder, initial chat message
Project card appears with 'Phase 0 - 0% complete' status
User navigated to Chat UI automatically
tasks: Create project creation service with validation logic
Add unit tests for validation edge cases
Add widget tests for modal UI
stories.technical_notes: Use file_picker ^6.0.0 for native file dialog. UUID generation: uuid.v5(NAMESPACE_DNS, projectPath)

stories.title: Open Existing Project
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want to reopen a previously created project so I can continue where I left off.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace screen displays all projects as cards (max 20 recent)
Each card shows: Name, Root Path, Last Modified, Phase Progress (e.g., 'Phase 2 - 40%')
Clicking card loads: chat history, generated documents, project settings
Error handling: if database corrupted, show 'Recreate or restore backup?' dialog
Support keyboard navigation: Arrow keys to select, Enter to open
tasks: Design project card widget with progress indicator
Implement project list query from projects.db
Add file watcher for context/ folder changes
Implement chat history loading from project_data.db
Add integration tests for project loading
stories.technical_notes: Use watch package for file system monitoring. Cache progress in SQLite to avoid repeated scans.

stories.title: Delete Project Metadata
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want to delete a project I no longer need, so my workspace stays clean.
acceptance_criteria: Long-press or right-click on project card reveals 'Delete Project' option
Confirmation dialog warns: 'This will delete metadata. Files in [path] will NOT be deleted. Continue?'
On confirmation, remove entry from projects.db
Do NOT delete files in root directory (user controls this manually)
Project card disappears with fade-out animation
tasks: Add context menu to project card widget
Design confirmation dialog with clear warning
Add unit tests for deletion logic
stories.technical_notes: Use showDialog with WillPopScope to prevent accidental dismissal during deletion.

stories.title: Project Progress Tracking
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want to see my project's completion percentage so I know how much documentation is ready.
acceptance_criteria: Progress bar shows: (documents_completed / 24) * 100%
Color coding: Red (0-30%), Yellow (31-70%), Green (71-100%)
Tooltip on hover lists missing documents
Progress updates in real-time when new document generated
tasks: Design progress bar widget with color states
Add tooltip with missing documents list
Cache progress in SQLite for performance
Add unit tests for progress calculation
stories.technical_notes: File system checks: context/VISION.md.exists() == true → +4.16%

epics.title: AI Chat Interface
epics.description: Conversational UI for asking questions and receiving AI-generated responses
epics.business_value: Core user interaction point, enables natural language project management
acceptance_criteria: User can send messages and receive streaming AI responses
Chat history persists per project
Markdown rendering with syntax highlighting
Error handling for network/LLM failures

stories.title: Send Message to AI
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want to type questions and receive AI responses so I can get instant guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Chat panel has text input at bottom with send button
Support multiline input (Shift+Enter for new line, Enter to send)
User message appears immediately with avatar + timestamp
Loading indicator while AI processes
AI response streams token-by-token (not all-at-once)
Messages persist to SQLite (chat_messages table)
Handle errors: Ollama offline → 'Switch to Groq?', Timeout → 'Retry?'
tasks: Design chat UI (input box, message bubbles, timestamps)
Implement error handling and recovery UI
Add unit tests for chat notifier
Add widget tests for chat UI
stories.technical_notes: Use http package with StreamedResponse for SSE. Backend: FastAPI EventSourceResponse.

stories.title: View Chat History
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want to scroll through past messages so I can recall previous decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Chat panel displays all messages for current project, sorted by timestamp
Auto-scroll to bottom when new message arrives
Limit displayed messages to last 100 (load more on scroll-up)
System messages (e.g., 'Document saved') have distinct styling (gray background)
tasks: Add unit tests for history loading
stories.technical_notes: Use ListView.builder with reverse: true for bottom-up scrolling.

stories.title: Markdown Rendering in Chat
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want code blocks and tables to render properly so responses are readable.
acceptance_criteria: Support: code blocks with syntax highlighting, tables, bold/italic, links, lists
Inline code uses monospace font with gray background
File paths render as clickable links (e.g., context/VISION.md opens preview)
tasks: Implement custom link handler for file paths
Add widget tests for Markdown rendering
stories.technical_notes: Use flutter_markdown ^0.6.18 with flutter_highlight for code blocks.

stories.title: Copy Code Blocks
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want to copy code snippets with one click so I don't have to manually select text.
acceptance_criteria: Code blocks have 'Copy' button in top-right corner
On click, button changes to 'Copied ✓' for 2 seconds
Code copied to clipboard without formatting artifacts
tasks: Add copy button to code block widget
Add unit tests for clipboard functionality
stories.technical_notes: Use clipboard ^0.1.3 package. Extract plain text from code block.

stories.title: Cancel Streaming Response
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want to stop a long-running AI response so I can rephrase my question.
acceptance_criteria: While streaming, show 'Stop Generating' button
On click, cancel SSE stream and display partial response with '[Cancelled]' indicator
Allow sending new message immediately
tasks: Add cancel button to chat UI
stories.technical_notes: Call StreamSubscription.cancel() to abort SSE stream.

epics.title: Automated Document Generation
epics.description: AI-powered generation of 24 project documents from interview responses
epics.business_value: Core value proposition: eliminate manual documentation work
acceptance_criteria: Generate Vision, Tech Stack, API Contract, Database Schema, Sprint Plan, etc.
No placeholders (all fields filled with real data)
Documents saved to correct paths (context/ folder)
User can review and approve before saving

stories.title: Generate Vision Document
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want the AI to create a Vision document from my interview answers so I have a clear project direction.
acceptance_criteria: User triggers generation via chat prompt: 'Create Vision Document'
AI uses interview responses + project context to generate document
Document includes: Problem Statement, Solution Overview, Target Users, Success Criteria, Risks
Saved to context/VISION.md with ISO 8601 timestamp
AI responds: '✅ Vision Document created. [View File](context/VISION.md)'
No placeholders like 'TODO' or '[Your Company Name]'
tasks: Integrate with LangChain for RAG context injection
Add unit tests for generation logic
Add integration tests for full generation flow
stories.technical_notes: Template path: knowledge_base/01-TEMPLATES/10-CONTEXT/VISION.template.md

stories.title: Generate Tech Stack Document
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want AI to recommend and justify a tech stack so I don't have to research frameworks for days.
acceptance_criteria: Document includes: Recommended stack, Alternatives with pros/cons, Justification, Learning resources
Stack recommendation aligns with project constraints (e.g., offline-first → no cloud-only services)
Saved to context/TECH_STACK.md
tasks: Query RAG for tech pack comparisons
Add unit tests for stack recommendation logic
stories.technical_notes: Scoring: Rate each stack against requirements (privacy, performance, dev experience).

stories.title: Generate API Contract
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want an OpenAPI specification generated so I can start implementing endpoints immediately.
acceptance_criteria: Document contains: OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec (YAML), All endpoints with schemas, Auth methods, Error codes
Endpoints match use cases from Functional Requirements
Saved to context/API_CONTRACT.yaml + context/API_CONTRACT.md (human-readable)
tasks: Add unit tests for schema generation
stories.technical_notes: Use openapi-pydantic for schema validation.

stories.title: Generate Database Schema
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want ER diagrams and SQL migration scripts so I can set up the database correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Document includes: ER diagram (Mermaid), Table definitions (SQL), Indexes, Relationships, Sample data
Schema matches API Contract (e.g., Project model → projects table)
Saved to context/DATABASE_SCHEMA.md
tasks: Add unit tests for schema generation
stories.technical_notes: Use Mermaid erDiagram syntax for visual representation.

stories.title: Document Review & Approval Flow
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want the AI to ask me to review generated docs so I can approve or request changes before saving.
acceptance_criteria: After generation, AI displays preview with buttons: [Approve] [Request Changes]
On 'Approve', save to file system and mark as complete
On 'Request Changes', user types feedback, AI regenerates with adjustments
Validation loop repeats max 3 times (prevent infinite revisions)
tasks: Store draft in memory until approved
Add unit tests for approval flow
stories.technical_notes: Show diff when regenerating (highlight changes with differ package).

epics.title: Workflow Orchestration
epics.description: Enforce phase-based progression with validation rules
epics.business_value: Prevents skipping critical steps, ensures documentation completeness
acceptance_criteria: Block progression to Phase N without completing Phase N-1
Display clear blocker messages with missing document list
Track completion status per phase

stories.title: Phase Prerequisite Enforcement
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want the AI to block me from generating Sprint Plans before Architecture is complete, so I don't skip critical steps.
acceptance_criteria: Before generating Phase N document, AI checks if Phase N-1 prerequisites are met
If missing, AI displays blocker message with missing document list and 'Would you like to generate these now?' prompt
Provide 'Override' button for advanced users (with warning)
Track phase completion in project_metadata table
tasks: Add unit tests for validation logic
Add integration tests for blocker flow
stories.technical_notes: Implement as middleware: _check_validation_blocker() before document generation.

stories.title: Workflow Roadmap Visualization
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want to see a visual roadmap of all phases so I know what's coming next.
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar shows phases 0-6 as progress timeline
Completed phases: green checkmark, Current: highlighted, Future: grayed out
Clicking phase expands document list
Clicking document name navigates to preview
stories.technical_notes: Use ExpansionTile widget for collapsible phase sections.

epics.title: Knowledge Base (RAG)
epics.description: Vector database for retrieving domain-specific knowledge
epics.business_value: Enables AI to provide accurate, context-aware responses with tech-specific best practices
acceptance_criteria: Tech packs ingested on first launch
Query returns top 5 most relevant chunks
Sub-1 second retrieval latency

stories.title: Ingest Tech Packs
stories.user_story: As a first-time user, I want the app to automatically load tech knowledge bases so RAG works out-of-the-box.
acceptance_criteria: On first launch, system ingests all files in packages/knowledge_base/02-TECH-PACKS/
Documents chunked (500 tokens per chunk, 50 token overlap) and embedded using all-MiniLM-L6-v2
Embeddings stored in ChromaDB collection: tech_knowledge
Progress bar shows: 'Indexing knowledge base... 142/200 documents'
Ingestion runs in background (non-blocking)
tasks: Add unit tests for chunking logic
Add integration tests for ingestion flow
stories.technical_notes: Use LangChain RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter. Cache in ~/.soft-architect-ai/embeddings_cache/

stories.title: Query Knowledge Base
stories.user_story: As a developer asking about FastAPI best practices, I want the AI to retrieve relevant examples from tech packs.
acceptance_criteria: When user sends message, backend performs vector search: embed query, retrieve top 5 chunks, inject into LLM prompt
AI responses cite sources: 'According to FastAPI Tech Pack, you should...'
If no relevant context (similarity < 0.6), fallback to LLM general knowledge
tasks: Add unit tests for search ranking
stories.technical_notes: Cosine similarity threshold: 0.6 (configurable). Max context: 4000 tokens.

epics.title: Settings & Configuration
epics.description: User preferences for LLM provider, themes, telemetry
acceptance_criteria: User can switch between Ollama (local) and Groq (cloud)
Theme selection (dark/light)
Telemetry opt-in/opt-out

stories.title: Select LLM Provider
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want to choose between local Ollama and cloud Groq so I can balance privacy vs. speed.
acceptance_criteria: Settings page has dropdown: 'LLM Provider' (Ollama Local / Groq Cloud)
If Ollama: show model dropdown (Llama 3.3 70B, Mistral 7B, DeepSeek Coder)
If Groq: require API key input (masked text field)
Test connection button: 'Verify LLM is reachable'
Settings saved to ~/.soft-architect-ai/config.json
tasks: Add API key input with validation
Add unit tests for config management
stories.technical_notes: Store API key encrypted using flutter_secure_storage.

stories.title: Configure Telemetry
stories.user_story: As a privacy-conscious developer, I want to opt out of anonymous usage tracking.
acceptance_criteria: First-launch modal: 'Help improve SoftArchitect AI? [Allow] [No Thanks]'
If allowed, collect: app version, OS version, crash reports, feature usage counts
NO collection of: project names, code snippets, prompts/responses, file paths
Can revoke consent anytime in Settings
tasks: Add unit tests for telemetry logic
stories.technical_notes: Use Sentry for crash reports. Telemetry endpoint: https://telemetry.softarchitect.ai/events
